note: UNHCR Refugee Population Statistics, end-year stocks. 'Refugees' = refugees under UNHCR's mandate plus other people in need of international protection (mostly Venezuelans in Latin America). Excludes asylum seekers, internally displaced people and about 6 million Palestine refugees under UNRWA's mandate. Origin 'unknown' and stateless are counted in totals but not in flows. Flows of at least 5,000 people.
